units.source_text: 天色朦胧向晓，霜华愈来愈重。

en.t: The sky grew dimly pale toward dawn, and the frost lay ever heavier.

units.source_text: 奏神乐的人饮酒过醉，奏得本末颠倒。

en.t: The kagura musicians had drunk too much, and their performance became confused from beginning to end.

units.source_text: 不知自己满面通红，只顾贪看美景。

en.t: Unaware that their own faces were flushed red, they cared only to gaze greedily at the beautiful scene.

units.source_text: 庭燎已经熄灭，他们还是挥舞着杨桐枝，高唱“千春千春，万岁万岁……”，为源氏祝福。

en.t: The courtyard torches had already gone out, yet they still waved paulownia branches and sang loudly, "A thousand springs, a thousand springs, ten thousand years, ten thousand years," blessing Genji.

units.source_text: 源氏子孙之繁昌，可保无疑了。

en.t: There could be no doubt that Genji's descendants would flourish.

units.source_text: 乐事层出不穷，永无餍足之时。

en.t: Pleasures followed one after another, with no moment when anyone felt satisfied enough.

units.source_text: 大家希望“千宵并作一宵长”，却不道转瞬天色已明。

en.t: Everyone wished that a thousand nights might be joined into one long night, but before they knew it the sky had brightened.

units.source_text: 诸青年像回波一般争先退去，心中不免痛惜。

en.t: The young men withdrew in a rush like returning waves, unable to keep from regretting that it was over.

units.source_text: 松原上排列着长长的一队车辆。

en.t: A long line of carriages stood arranged along the pine grove.

units.source_text: 晓风扬起帘脚，露出女眷的衣裾来，好似常绿树底下开出了烂漫的春花。

en.t: The dawn wind lifted the curtain edges and revealed the hems of the ladies' robes, like brilliant spring flowers blooming beneath evergreen trees.

units.source_text: 各车辆的伺候人员，按照各主人身份而穿着各种颜色的袍子，拿着精美的盘子，分别请车中主人进膳。

en.t: The attendants of each carriage, dressed in robes of various colors according to their masters' ranks, carried elegant trays and separately invited the occupants to take their meal.

units.source_text: 下级人员都注目观看，不胜艳羡。

en.t: The lower-ranking attendants all watched intently, overcome with envy and admiration.

units.source_text: 呈送给老尼姑的是素食，盛在一只嫩沉香木盘子里，上面覆着青宝蓝色帕子。

en.t: What was presented to the old nun was vegetarian food, served on a pale aloeswood tray and covered with a deep blue cloth.

units.source_text: 观者私下议论，都说：“真荣耀啊！这女人定是前世积德的吧！”

en.t: The onlookers whispered among themselves, all saying, "What an honor! This woman must surely have accumulated virtue in a former life."

units.source_text: 来时带着无数供养品，一路上途为之塞。

en.t: On the way there they had brought countless offerings, so many that the road was blocked by them.

units.source_text: 但归时负担轻松了，一路上可以逍遥自在地游山玩水。

en.t: But on the return journey their burden was lighter, and they could wander freely through the mountains and waters along the way.

units.source_text: 但此等琐屑之事，无须一一赘述。

en.t: But such trivial matters need not be described one by one.

units.source_text: 老尼姑与明石夫人想起了离居荒山、不闻不见的明石道人，觉得只此一事深可遗憾。

en.t: The old nun and Lady Akashi thought of the Akashi monk, living apart in the remote mountains and seeing and hearing nothing of this, and felt that this alone was deeply regrettable.

units.source_text: 但念这老和尚如果也来参与这盛会，则又不很雅观。

en.t: Yet they reflected that if the old monk had also come to take part in this splendid gathering, it would not have looked very graceful either.

units.source_text: 惟世人都以老尼姑为范例，认为当今之世，志气应该高远。

en.t: Still, people everywhere took the old nun as an example and thought that in the present age one ought to set one's ambitions high.

units.source_text: 到处盛称老尼姑的幸福，世间就多了一个典故：凡称道幸福之人，必曰“明石尼姑”。

en.t: Everywhere people loudly praised the old nun's good fortune, and so a new saying arose in the world: whenever someone praised a fortunate person, they would surely say, "the Akashi nun."

units.source_text: 现已致仕的太政大臣家的小姐近江君，打双六时口中必高呼“明石尼姑，明石尼姑！”借以求赢。

en.t: Omi no Kimi, the daughter of the now-retired Chancellor's household, would always shout "Akashi nun, Akashi nun!" when playing sugoroku, using it as a charm to win.
